question: Which Indian state has the world's longest highway tunnel (as of July 2023)?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Himachal Pradesh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The world's longest highway tunnel, as of **July 2023**, is the **Atal Tunnel**, which is located in the state of **Himachal Pradesh**, India.
 
• The **Atal Tunnel** is named after **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**, the former Prime Minister of India.
